title: Glowing hourglass
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='woodTop' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#e8a34a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#b9702a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='woodBot' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#b9702a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#8a4f1c'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='sandTop' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#fff2a8'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#f5c542'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='sandBot' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffd85e'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#e8a020'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='glassGlow' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#9fe8ff' stop-opacity='0.75'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#5fc8ff' stop-opacity='0.45'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- gentle glow halo -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='34' ry='40' fill='#4fc3f7' opacity='0.12'/>

  <!-- glass body (hourglass silhouette) -->
  <path d='M32 20 L68 20 L68 24 C68 38 54 46 50 50 C54 54 68 62 68 76 L68 80 L32 80 L32 76 C32 62 46 54 50 50 C46 46 32 38 32 24 Z'
        fill='url(#glassGlow)' stroke='#bfeaff' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- top sand -->
  <path d='M35 25 L65 25 L65 28 C65 37 54 44 50 48 C46 44 35 37 35 28 Z' fill='url(#sandTop)'/>

  <!-- falling stream -->
  <rect x='48.5' y='47' width='3' height='10' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <rect x='49' y='56' width='2' height='6' fill='#ffd34d'/>

  <!-- bottom sand pile -->
  <path d='M35 75 C37 66 44 62 50 62 C56 62 63 66 65 75 Z' fill='url(#sandBot)'/>
  <path d='M38 75 C40 68 45 65 50 65 C55 65 60 68 62 75 Z' fill='#ffe680' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- sparkles of glow -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='34' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='40' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='70' r='1.3' fill='#fffbe0' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- wooden caps -->
  <rect x='28' y='14' width='44' height='7' rx='3' fill='url(#woodTop)'/>
  <rect x='28' y='79' width='44' height='7' rx='3' fill='url(#woodBot)'/>

  <!-- cap highlights -->
  <rect x='31' y='15.5' width='38' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ffd08a' opacity='0.75'/>
  <rect x='31' y='80.5' width='38' height='2' rx='1' fill='#d98c44' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- little feet -->
  <rect x='34' y='86' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8a4f1c'/>
  <rect x='59' y='86' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8a4f1c'/>
</svg>
